entry.author: 1News
entry.summary:
This week’s ASB Good as Gold recipient is Mike Taylor of Riversdale. 

Mike has given more than 20 years of service to Surf Life Saving at Riversdale Beach as a lifeguard, trainer, examiner and long‑standing Club Captain. Under Mike’s leadership, the Riversdale Beach Surf Life Saving Club has achieved national success while remaining a welcoming hub for young lifeguards. 

Mike is also a trusted first responder whose commitment has helped keep a remote coastal community safe for decades. Often first on the scene for medical emergencies, Mike is effectively on call 24/7, providing critical care while ambulances or helicopters travel long distances to reach Riversdale. Over the years, his calm, dependable presence has made a life changing difference for countless locals and visitors. A farmer, long‑serving Rural Fire Force volunteer, and many other roles, Mike’s contribution is defined by humility, service and an unwavering dedication to others. ASB is thrilled to recognise Mike with $10,000 as this week’s ASB Good as Gold recipient.
